span.p: Yes - AMI-CS

span.p:
Biventricular or
refractory arrest

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: No - improving

div.style: color: rgb(136, 19, 55) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
SUSPECT SHOCK
SBP under 90 for 30 min
or pressors to hold 90
PLUS hypoperfusion

div.style: color: rgb(120, 53, 15) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
ACT IN THE FIRST 10 MIN
ECG - troponin - lactate
bedside echo - art line
ACTIVATE SHOCK TEAM

div.style: color: rgb(49, 46, 129) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Is it the pump?
Echo - low EF - dilated LV
rule out tamponade - PE
RV infarct - valve rupture

div.style: color: rgb(22, 78, 99) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: Pericardiocentesis

div.style: color: rgb(22, 78, 99) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Thrombolysis or
embolectomy

div.style: color: rgb(22, 78, 99) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
FLUIDS not diuresis
keep AV synchrony

div.style: color: rgb(22, 78, 99) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Surgery emergently
MCS as a bridge

div.style: color: rgb(12, 74, 110) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
CLASSIFY THE PROFILE
wet-cold - dry-cold
euvolaemic-cold

div.style: color: rgb(6, 78, 59) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
NOREPINEPHRINE first
0.05 then titrate
target MAP 65
SOAP II - OptimaCC

div.style: color: rgb(49, 46, 129) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Perfusion restored?
lactate falling
UOP over 0.5

div.style: color: rgb(6, 78, 59) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
ADD AN INOTROPE
dobutamine 2.5 to 20
or milrinone if on
beta-blocker - DOREMI

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
WEAN - treat the cause
start GDMT when off pressors

div.style: color: rgb(49, 46, 129) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: Is it AMI-CS?

div.style: color: rgb(22, 78, 99) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
EMERGENT PCI
CULPRIT VESSEL ONLY
SHOCK trial - CULPRIT-SHOCK
no routine multivessel

div.style: color: rgb(49, 46, 129) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
SCAI stage D or E
rising lactate
escalating pressors

div.style: color: rgb(76, 29, 149) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
MICROAXIAL PUMP
Impella CP
DanGer Shock - NNT 8
watch bleeding - haemolysis

div.style: color: rgb(76, 29, 149) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
VA-ECMO
not routine - ECLS-SHOCK
needs LV venting

div.style: color: rgb(49, 46, 129) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
BRIDGE DECISION
recovery - durable LVAD
transplant - or palliation
